create_mamba_inference_params: create inference parameters with conv states and ssm states for a Mamba model batch
build_mambabatch_from_pb: build a MambaBatch from a protobuf batch request with tokenized inputs and sampling parameters
filter_mambabatch: filter a MambaBatch to keep only specific request IDs and update inference states accordingly
concatenate_mambabatches: concatenate multiple MambaBatch instances into a single batch with merged inference parameters
generate_mamba_token: generate the next token for a Mamba model batch using forward pass and token selection
